Because everyone has different weekends, we will just divide the monthly amount over the total number of days in the month and apply to every day. We can then aggregate up to the 'week' using the date dim table.

I had thought about making the table a 'weekly' budget and forecast to help keep the rows down, but it wont work because the week often crosses over the month.

I expect the rows to be about 100m for the forecast table. That sounds high at first, but my S&OP has been using a daily forecast table for nearly 2 years and it loads very quick and the visuals load in 1 second.
